subject: Executive briefing orchestration & MAP sync — Cedar Analytics close plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@cedaranalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive briefing orchestration & MAP sync — Cedar Analytics close plan

Anna — quick note following our product evaluation sync this morning. I put together an initial mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed executive briefing (EB) choreography to help unblock the final stages of the evaluation and procurement. Attaching a draft MAP and a slot grid.

High level asks:
- Confirm the Cedar execs who should attend the EB (title + availability).
- Confirm the gating criteria Cedar will require to sign (legal, procurement, and performance checkpoints).
- Pick one of the EB slots below or propose two alternatives. We’ll lock the MAP milestones once we align on attendees.

Proposed EB slots (all PT):
- Tue, Jun 15 — 10:00–11:00 PT (Redwood exec + SE deep dive)
- Thu, Jun 17 — 14:00–15:00 PT (short exec presentation + Q/A)

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), EB_slot_proposals.xlsx (editable grid), Eval-checklist.csv (gating checklist).

Quick MAP summary (draft):
- Week 1: Exec briefing (confirm sponsors, align success metrics)
- Week 2: Technical deep-dive + performance runbook (SE-led)
- Week 3: Security & legal checkpoint (SOC2 evidence, retention policy)
- Week 4: Final pricing & signatures (DocuSign)

Goal: close by end of June conditional on procurement windows. If you want us to split the EB into two shorter sessions (exec + technical), we can do that too.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks for the draft and the clear timetable. A couple of notes from procurement and our exec office: 

1) Procurement is insisting on having the performance SLOs and a short audit-log evidence pack before the exec meeting; can you confirm we’ll have those outputs available (even as sample runs)?
2) Danielle (copied) prefers the EB earlier in the week if possible — Wed/Thu this week are tight for her. Would you have any availability Mon/Tue morning PT?

Also, can you call out who from Redwood will be the single exec sponsor in the EB? That helps our organizers lock rooms.

Thanks —
Anna
Anna Lee | Head of Product Strategy | Cedar Analytics

Subject: Re: Executive briefing orchestration & MAP sync — Cedar Analytics close plan

Anna — thanks, understood on the procurement ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide sample perf runs (30-min smoke test + 1-hour throughput report) and a curated audit pack (SOC2 artifacts + retention summary) before the EB.

To make scheduling easier, below is a concise exec-attendee mapping and an adjusted slot list (we can compress the EB to 45 minutes if you prefer). If you confirm names on your side, we’ll issue calendar invites and a final MAP with locked milestones.

Proposed Redwood EB roles (one-liners):
- Executive sponsor: Rishi Malhotra — VP, GTM Strategy (will lead commercial + pricing discussion)
- Technical sponsor: Karthik Iyer — Solutions Engineering Lead (will run the SE deep-dive)
- Account lead: Marissa Cole — Director, Strategic Accounts (program owner and MAP shepherd)

Requested Cedar attendees (please confirm titles):
- Executive sponsor: (your exec) — suggested: Danielle Brooks, VP Procurement (for procurement sign-off)
- Business sponsor: (your exec) — recommended: Anna Lee, Head of Product Strategy
- Technical reviewer: (your SE) — recommended: Samir Gupta (consultant)

Adjusted EB slots (PT):
- Mon, Jun 14 — 09:00–09:45 PT (exec + short runbook)
- Tue, Jun 15 — 10:00–11:00 PT (longer—includes SE deep-dive)

MAP updates (we’ll version this as v1.1 after you confirm attendees):
- Milestone A (EB): confirm exec attendees -> goal: align success metrics and close date
- Milestone B (Perf validation): deliver sample perf runs + throughput report -> target: 48 hours post-EB
- Milestone C (Security/Legal): provide SOC2 artifacts + retention plan -> target: 5 business days post-EB
- Milestone D (Commercial): finalize pricing and DocuSign -> target: 7 business days post-legal sign-off

Next steps: please confirm who from Cedar will play the executive sponsor and whether Mon 6/14 09:00 PT works. Once confirmed, Rishi and I will be on the invite.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive briefing orchestration & MAP sync — Cedar Analytics close plan

Marissa/Anna — quick operational note from the SE side. I’ll run the technical portion and the perf smoke on the 15th if we pick that slot. Couple of items to call out so procurement has visibility: 

- Perf gating: we’ll provide a 30-min low-latency run and a 1-hour throughput run. Expected deliverables: latency percentiles (p50/p95), token throughput, and cost-per-1k-token estimate.
- Test access: to run the full checks we need a short-lived test key and a target dataset (~10k tokens). Can Cedar confirm a dataset or allow us to use a synthetic sample?
- Audit artifacts: I’ll attach the SOC2 evidence index and a short write-up of our retention policies to the calendar invite.

If procurement wants a stand-alone security call prior to EB, we can schedule a 30-min session on Wed 6/16. Otherwise we’ll include a 10–12 minute security section in the EB.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Solutions Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SE_perf_plan.docx (DOCX, 28KB)]
